description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the George Mason University of the United States of America and the Arthur C. Clarke Institute for Modern Technologies to promote Research Collaboration in the field of Science and Technology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between George Mason University in the United States of America and the Arthur C. Clarke Institute for Modern Technologies in Sri Lanka with the objective of facilitating a mutually beneficial research collaboration, including the identification of research challenges and the development of technical solutions between the two parties. Under the said MoU, which will be effective for a period of five (05) years, both parties have agreed to collaborate in the areas of cybersecurity, unmanned aerial vehicles, space and satellites, artificial intelligence and machine learning and 5G communications. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Science and Technology to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the George Mason University of the United States of America and the Arthur C. Clarke Institute for Modern Technologies in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.
